children: Midnight plans to roll out support for tokenized deposits in Q4 2026. The release will let institutions use the network to issue and settle digital deposits.

Institutions will be able to carry out both steps without making deposit balances public or revealing which businesses they deal with. Support for that banking activity gives NIGHT exposure to a new institutional use case.
So, let’s take a look at what
has planned for us in 2027, and there’s a lot, so we’re going to break it down into categories:
